div.head: II Cn 13.1
div.ab: And gyf he bocland habbe, þæt sy forworht þam cingce to handa, si ðæs mannes man, þe he sig.
And gyf he bocland hæbbe, sy þæt forworht þam cyningce to handa, sy þæs mannes man, þe he sy.
Et si terram testamentalem habeat (quę Anglice dicitur bócland), ipsa in manum regis transeat, sit eius homo cuius sit.
⁊ gyf he bócland habbe, sy þæt forworht ðam cynge to hánde, sy ðæs mannes man ðe he sy.
And gyf he bocland hæbbe, þæt sy forworht þam cingce to handa, si ðæs mannes man, þe he sig.
And if he has land held by title-deed, it shall be forfeited into the hands of the king without regard to the question whose vassal he is.
And if he holds land by charter, it shall be forfeited into the king’s hand, no matter which lord he serves.
And if he has bookland, it is to be forfeited into the king’s possession, no matter whose man he be.
Und wenn jener ein kraft [Königs-]Urkunde [besessenes] Land hat, so sei dieses dem König zur Hand verwirkt, sei er welches Mannes Vasall er auch sei.
And if he has bookland, let it be forfeited into the king's hand, whosever man he may be.
